task_title: PHASE3-TS-3: time-series between() read pruning via chunk index (spec 4.2/6.3/8.2)
task_criteria: between() on the time field with explicit {index: '<time_field>'} returns exactly the rows whose ts is in the window (live E2E, spec 6.3)
plain between() (no index optarg) with ReQL time bounds on a time-series table resolves to the time field and returns the same rows (spec 2.3 example/6.3)
chunk pruning: between bounds parsed to [start_us,end_us), overlapping_chunks() scopes the scan to overlapping chunk B-trees only; rows from non-overlapping chunks absent (spec 4.2 steps 1-4)
boundary correctness: closed/open bounds, empty window, inverted range, unbounded minval/maxval, range over no chunk all handled without error or crash
regression: pkey between, getAll, count, and plain-table between unchanged (byte-identical non-TS path)
backfill rows (older than chunk layout) returned by between; chunk layout and pruned reads survive server restart
unit tests pass: TimeSeries suite 18/18 (incl. new TS-3 chunk-pruning boundary tests)
regression: 238/238 filtered unit tests pass; test/ts3_e2e_probe.py 28/28 PASS
build passes clean (make -j4); no TSDBG debug prints in TS-3 files
